verdict.rationale: Trivy's docs explicitly state built-in misconfiguration checks for Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation and more, plus k8s cluster scanning via `trivy k8s`, and community reviews corroborate strong CI/CD IaC scanning usage. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Terraform/K8s misconfig detection accuracy (only Docker/vuln scanning has community corroboration).
